profile.headline: Senior Staff Software Engineer | Agentic AI & LLMs | Full Stack | 6 Patents
profile.summary:
I'm a Lead Software Engineer with 28 years of experience building products that people actually use — from distributed telecom platforms at Alcatel in France to enterprise SaaS at scale at Salesforce, where I spent 14 years.
At Salesforce I've worked across two major product areas. On the Einstein Conversation Insights team, I was one of the founding engineers — I helped design the voice media player, built the transcript and action-item surfaces, and led the development of ECI Signals, which aggregates conversation intelligence for sales teams at scale. More recently, I've been deeply embedded in AI-centric development: building agentic features on Data Lake and Data Model Objects, designing retrieval and search indexes for agents, engineering GPT prompts, and developing with Claude Code and Claude Skills. I've also led our observability strategy, giving engineers, PMs, and executives real visibility into feature health and adoption. I have also led the Calendar team in its transformation towards a component-based UI redesign. Along the way, I've led multiple patent efforts and mentored engineers who've gone on to join our teams full-time.
What I'm best at is the space between complex backend systems and the product experience — understanding both what's technically sound and what actually serves users. I move comfortably between early-stage design, cross-team alignment, and hands-on implementation. I take ownership of the hard, ambiguous problems and see them through.
I hold 6 granted US patents covering calendar productivity, database recommendation systems, and UI architecture — work that came out of leading technical innovation efforts across two product teams.
I'm originally from France (ESIGETEL engineering school, then Alcatel Research), have been in the Bay Area for over 20 years, and am based in Marin. I'm open to roles onsite, hybrid, or remote — and actively looking for my next opportunity in AI product engineering, enterprise SaaS, or platform/infrastructure at a company where engineering still matters.
If you're working on something interesting, I'd love to hear about it.

positions.title: Lead Member of Technical Staff
positions.description:
AI & Agentic Engineering

Adopted an AI-centric development cycle using Claude Code and built proprietary Claude Skills to accelerate team productivity and code quality
Designed and built agentic features on Salesforce's Data Lake Objects and Data Model Objects, powering AI agent workflows
Engineered GPT prompts integrated into Einstein AI product surfaces
Explored codebase modernization: increased modularity, introduced progressive rollout gates, and expanded test coverage to support safer iteration at scale

Einstein Conversation Insights (ECI) — Founding Engineer

Founding engineer on ECI, Salesforce's conversation intelligence product for sales teams; contributed across the full product surface from inception, allowing thousands of organizations to process voice and video calls and gain insights
Designed and built the voice media player, enabling sales reps to replay and review customer calls directly within Salesforce
Built core product features: voice transcript component, notification system, action item insights, and call structure visualization
Led end-to-end design and delivery of ECI Signals — an aggregated conversation intelligence surface exposing real-time sales signals to end users; owned technical decisions and coordinated execution across partner teams
Architected the team's observability and logging strategy, giving engineering, product, and executive stakeholders visibility into feature health, enablement, and adoption

Salesforce Calendar — Tech Lead

Led engineering for Salesforce's next-generation Calendar product; owned release planning, feature research, and cross-team dependency management
Delivered multiple Calendar features from design through production

Named inventor on 6 granted US patents spanning calendar productivity, intelligent database recommendations, and UI data architecture (USPTO: 11,604,765 · 10,977,236 · 10,817,815 · 10,592,866 · 10,504,069 · 10,417,183)
